40020633.author: पदार्थः
40020633.content: ततः then, वित्रासयन् terrifying, मर्त्यान् mortals, पृथिव्याम् on earth, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of demons, आससाद met, घने in that dense (region), तस्मिन् that, नारदम् Narada, मुनिपुङ्गवम् the foremost among sages.

40020633.author: Translation
40020633.content: Then, the lord of demons, terrifying mortals on earth, met Narada, the foremost among sages, in that dense region.

40020634.author: पदार्थः
40020634.content: तस्य his, अभिवादनम् salutation, कृत्वा having done, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, अब्रवीत् spoke, कुशलम् well-being, पृष्ट्वा having asked, हेतुम् the reason, आगमनस्य for coming, च and.

40020634.author: Translation
40020634.content: Having offered his salutations, Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, spoke after inquiring about his well-being and the reason for his arrival.

40020635.author: पदार्थः
40020635.content: नारदः Narada, तु indeed, महातेजा of great splendor, देवर्षिः the divine sage, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable effulgence, अब्रवीत् spoke, मेघपृष्ठस्थः situated on a cloud-top, रावणं to Ravana, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka (chariot), स्थितम् who was situated.

40020635.author: Translation
40020635.content: The divine sage Narada, of immense splendor and effulgence, spoke to Ravana, who was seated in the Pushpaka chariot, while Narada himself was positioned on a cloud-top.

40020636.author: पदार्थः
40020636.content: राक्षसाधिपते O lord of Rakshasas, सौम्य O gentle one, तिष्ठ stop, विश्रवसः of Vishravas, सुत O son, प्रीतो pleased, अस्मि I am, अभिजनोपेतविक्रमैः by valor endowed with noble birth, ऊर्जितैः mighty, तव your.

40020636.author: Translation
40020636.content: "O gentle lord of Rakshasas, son of Vishravas, stop," Narada said, "I am pleased by your mighty valor, which is befitting your noble lineage."

40020637.author: पदार्थः
40020637.content: विष्णुना by Vishnu, दैत्यघातैः by the slaying of Daityas, च and, गन्धर्वोरगधर्षणैः by the subjugation of Gandharvas and Uragas, त्वया by you, समं equal, विमर्दैः by battles, च and, भृशं greatly, हि indeed, परितोषितः I am pleased.

40020637.author: Translation
40020637.content: I am indeed greatly pleased by your battles, which are comparable to Vishnu's slaying of demons and your subjugation of Gandharvas and Uragas.

40020638.author: पदार्थः
40020638.content: किंचित् something, वक्ष्यामि I will say, तावत् first, ते to you, श्रोतव्यं to be heard, श्रोष्यसे you will hear, यदि if, श्रुत्वा having heard, च and, अनन्तरं afterwards, कार्यं to be done, त्वया by you, राक्षससत्तम O best of Rakshasas, तत् that, मे by me, निगदतः while speaking, तात O dear one, समाधिं attention, श्रवणे in listening, कुरु make.

40020638.author: Translation
40020638.content: I will first tell you something that should be heard, if you are willing to listen, and after hearing it, you, O best of Rakshasas, must act upon it; therefore, O dear one, pay close attention to my words.

40020639.author: पदार्थः
40020639.content: किम् why, अयं this (world/people), वध्यते is being killed, तात O dear one, त्वया by you, अवध्येन who is not to be killed, दैवतैः by gods, हतः killed, एव indeed, हि surely, अयं this, लोकः world/people, यदा when, मृत्युवशं under the sway of death, गतः gone.

40020639.author: Translation
40020639.content: O dear one, why do you kill this world, which is already destined to die and cannot be killed by the gods, when it is already under the sway of death?

40020640.author: पदार्थः
40020640.content: देवदानवदैत्यानां of gods, danavas, and daityas, यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् of yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas, अवध्येन by one who is not to be killed, त्वया by you, लोकः the world, क्लेष्टुं to torment, युक्तो fit, न not, मानुषः human.

40020640.author: Translation
40020640.content: It is not proper for you, who are invincible to gods, danavas, daityas, yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas, to torment the human world.

40020641.author: पदार्थः
40020641.content: नित्यं constantly, श्रेयसि in welfare, सम्मूढं bewildered, महद्भिः by great, व्यसनैः calamities, वृतम् surrounded, हन्यात् would kill, कः who, तादृशं such, लोकं people, जराव्याधिशतैः by hundreds of old age and diseases, युतम् afflicted.

40020641.author: Translation
40020641.content: Who would kill such people who are constantly bewildered about their welfare, surrounded by great misfortunes, and afflicted by hundreds of old age and diseases?

40020642.author: पदार्थः
40020642.content: तैस्तैः by those various, अनिष्टोपगमैः by undesirable occurrences, अजस्रं constantly, यत्र where, कुत्र anywhere, कः who, मतिमान् intelligent, मानुषे in the human, लोके world, युद्धेन by war, प्रणयी desirous, भवेत् would be.

40020642.author: Translation
40020642.content: Who among the intelligent would be fond of war in the human world, which is constantly afflicted by various undesirable occurrences everywhere?

40020643.author: पदार्थः
40020643.content: क्षीयमाणं wasting away, दैवहतं struck by fate, श्रुत्पिपासाजरादिभिः by hunger, thirst, old age, and others, विषादशोकसम्मूढं bewildered by dejection and sorrow, लोकं people, त्वं you, क्षपयस्व destroy, मा not.

40020643.author: Translation
40020643.content: Do not you destroy the human world, which is already wasting away, struck by fate, afflicted by hunger, thirst, old age, and other miseries, and bewildered by dejection and sorrow.

40020644.author: पदार्थः
40020644.content: पश्य behold, तावत just, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, राक्षसेश्वर O lord of Rakshasas, मानुषम् human being, मूढम् foolish, एवम् thus, विचित्रार्थं having strange purposes, यस्य whose, न not, ज्ञायते is known, गतिः destiny.

40020644.author: Translation
40020644.content: O mighty-armed lord of Rakshasas, just behold the human being, who is so foolish and whose strange nature or destiny is not truly known.

40020645.author: पदार्थः
40020645.content: क्वचित् at times, वादित्रनृत्यादि musical instruments and dance etc., सेव्यते are enjoyed, मुदितैः by joyful, जनैः people, रुद्यते is wept, च and, अपरैः by others, आर्तैः by distressed, धाराश्रुनयनाननैः with faces and eyes streaming with tears.

40020645.author: Translation
40020645.content: At times, joyful people engage in music and dance, while at other times, distressed individuals weep with faces and eyes streaming with tears.

40020646.author: पदार्थः
40020646.content: मातापितृसुतस्नेहैः by the affections for mother, father, and son, भार्याबन्धुमनोरमैः by charming wife and relatives, मोहितः deluded, अयम् this, जनः person, ध्वस्तः afflicted, क्लेशम् suffering, स्वम् own, न not, अवबुध्यते understands.

40020646.author: Translation
40020646.content: Deluded by affection for parents, children, charming wives, and relatives, this afflicted person does not comprehend his own suffering.

40020647.author: पदार्थः
40020647.content: अलम् enough, एनम् this, परिक्लिश्य having tormented, लोकम् world, मोहनिराकृतम् overcome by delusion, जितः conquered, एव indeed, त्वया by you, सौम्य O gentle one, मर्त्यलोकः the mortal world, न not, संशयः doubt.

40020647.author: Translation
40020647.content: Enough of tormenting this world, which is already overcome by delusion; O gentle one, the mortal world has indeed been conquered by you, there is no doubt about it.

40020648.author: पदार्थः
40020648.content: अवश्यम् inevitably, एभिः by these, सर्वैः all, च and, गन्तव्यम् must go, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, तत् therefore, निगृह्णीष्व subdue, पौलस्त्य O son of Pulastya, यमम् Yama, परपुरञ्जय O conqueror of enemy cities.

40020648.author: Translation
40020648.content: All these beings must inevitably go to the abode of Yama, therefore, O son of Pulastya, O conqueror of enemy cities, subdue Yama himself.

40020649.author: पदार्थः
40020649.content: तस्मिन् when he, जिते is conquered, जितम् conquered, सर्वम् all, भवति becomes, एव indeed, न not, संशयः doubt, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, दीप्यमानम् shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, अब्रवीत् spoke, नारदम् to Narada, तत्र there, सम्प्रहस्य having laughed heartily, अभिवाद्य having saluted, च and.

40020649.author: Translation
40020649.content: When Yama is conquered, everything is indeed conquered, there is no doubt; thus addressed, the lord of Lanka, shining with his own splendor, then spoke to Narada, having laughed heartily and saluted him.

40020650.author: पदार्थः
40020650.content: महर्षे O great sage, देवगन्धर्वविहार O one who sports with gods and gandharvas, समरप्रिय O lover of battle, अहम् I, समुद्यतः am ready, गन्तुम् to go, विजयार्थम् for the sake of victory, रसातलम् to Rasatala.

40020650.author: Translation
40020650.content: Ravana addresses the sage, declaring his readiness to descend to Rasatala for conquest.

40020651.author: पदार्थः
40020651.content: ततः Then, लोकत्रयम् the three worlds, जित्वा having conquered, स्थाप्य having placed, नागान् the Nagas, सुरान् the gods, वशे under control, समुद्रम् the ocean, अमृतार्थम् for the sake of nectar, च and, मथिष्यामि I will churn, रसालयम् the abode of waters.

40020651.author: Translation
40020651.content: Ravana further states that after conquering the three worlds and subjugating the Nagas and gods, he will churn the ocean for nectar.

40020652.author: पदार्थः
40020652.content: अथ Then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, नारदः Narada, भगवान् the divine, ऋषिः sage, क्व where, खलु indeed, इदानीम् now, मार्गेण by which path, त्वया by you, हि surely, अन्येन by another, गम्यते is it gone (are you going).

40020652.author: Translation
40020652.content: Then, the divine sage Narada asked Ravana, "By which path are you indeed going now?"

40020653.author: पदार्थः
40020653.content: अयम् This, खलु indeed, सुदुर्गम्यः very difficult to traverse, प्रेतराजपुरम् to the city of the king of the dead, प्रति towards, मार्गः path, गच्छति goes, दुर्धर्षः unassailable, यमस्य of Yama, अमित्रकर्शन O tormentor of enemies.

40020653.author: Translation
40020653.content: Narada warns Ravana that this path, O tormentor of enemies, is indeed very difficult to traverse and leads to the formidable city of Yama, the king of the dead.

40020654.author: पदार्थः
40020654.content: सः He, तु but, शारदमेघाभम् resembling an autumn cloud, हासम् a laugh, मुक्त्वा having let out, दशाननः Dashanana, उवाच said, कृतम् done, इति एव thus only, वचनम् words, च and, इदम् these, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020654.author: Translation
40020654.content: Dashanana, however, let out a laugh resembling an autumn cloud and then spoke these words, saying, "It is done."

40020655.author: पदार्थः
40020655.content: तस्मात् therefore, एवम् thus, अहम् I, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, वैवस्वतवधोद्यतः intent on killing Vaivasvata (Yama), गच्छामि I go, दक्षिणाम् southern, आशाम् direction, यत्र where, सूर्यात्मजः the son of Surya, नृपः the king.

40020655.author: Translation
40020655.content: Therefore, O Brahmana, being thus intent on slaying Vaivasvata (Yama), I proceed to the southern direction where the son of Surya, the king (Yama), resides.

40020656.author: पदार्थः
40020656.content: मया by me, हि indeed, भगवन् O revered one, क्रोधात् out of anger, प्रतिज्ञातम् it has been vowed, रणार्थिना by one desirous of battle, अवजेष्यामि I shall conquer, चतुरः the four, लोकपालान् guardians of the world, इति thus, प्रभो O lord.

40020656.author: Translation
40020656.content: Indeed, O revered one, I, desirous of battle, have vowed in my anger, "I shall conquer the four guardians of the world, O lord."

40020657.author: पदार्थः
40020657.content: तत् therefore, इह now, प्रस्थितः having set out, अहम् I, वै indeed, प्रेतराजपुरम् to the city of the king of the dead, प्रति towards, प्राणिसङ्क्लेशकर्तारम् the one who causes distress to living beings, योजयिष्यामि I shall unite, मृत्युना with death.

40020657.author: Translation
40020657.content: Therefore, I have now indeed set out towards the city of the king of the dead, and I shall unite with death the one who causes distress to living beings.

40020658.author: पदार्थः
40020658.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), मुनिम् the sage, तम् him, अभिवाद्य having saluted, च and, प्रययौ he departed, दक्षिणाम् southern, आशाम् direction, प्रविष्टः having entered, सह with, मन्त्रिभिः his ministers.

40020658.author: Translation
40020658.content: Having thus spoken and saluted that sage, Dashagriva (Ravana) departed towards the southern direction, accompanied by his ministers.

40020659.author: पदार्थः
40020659.content: नारदः Narada, तु but, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, ध्यानम् meditation, आस्थितः having assumed, चिन्तयामास he pondered, विप्रेन्द्रः the chief among Brahmanas, विधूमः smokeless, इव like, पावकः fire.

40020659.author: Translation
40020659.content: But the greatly effulgent Narada, the chief among Brahmanas, having assumed meditation for a moment, pondered like a smokeless fire.

40020660.author: पदार्थः
40020660.content: येन by whom, लोकाः worlds, त्रयः three, सेन्द्राः including Indra, क्लिश्यन्ते are tormented, सचराचराः with all moving and non-moving beings, क्षीणे when exhausted, च and, आयुषि in lifespan, धर्मेण by the law of nature/dharma, सः that, कालः Time/Death, जेष्यते will be conquered, कथम् how

40020660.author: Translation
40020660.content: How can that Time, by whom the three worlds including Indra and all animate and inanimate beings are tormented, and by whose law life itself is exhausted, ever be conquered?

40020661.author: पदार्थः
40020661.content: स्वदत्तकृतसाक्षी who is a witness to one's own deeds, यः who, द्वितीयः second, इव like, पावकः fire, लब्धसञ्ज्ञाः having gained consciousness, विजेष्यन्ते will be conquered, लोकाः worlds, यस्य whose, महात्मनः of the great soul (Yama)

40020661.author: Translation
40020661.content: How can one conquer that great being (Yama), who is a witness to all deeds, like a second fire, and by whom all conscious beings in the worlds are eventually overcome?

40020662.author: पदार्थः
40020662.content: यस्य from whom, नित्यं always, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, विद्रवन्ति flee, भयार्दिताः tormented by fear, तं him, कथं how, राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of Rakshasas, असौ this, स्वयमेव by himself, गमिष्यति will go (to conquer)

40020662.author: Translation
40020662.content: How can this king of Rakshasas (Ravana) personally go to conquer him, from whom the three worlds always flee, tormented by fear?

40020663.author: पदार्थः
40020663.content: यः who, विधाता the ordainer, च and, धाता the sustainer, च and, सुकृतं good deeds, दुष्कृतं bad deeds, तथा also, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, विजितं conquered, येन by whom, तं him, कथं how, विजयिष्यते will he conquer

40020663.author: Translation
40020663.content: How will he conquer him who is the ordainer and sustainer of both good and bad deeds, and by whom the three worlds are already subdued?

40020664.author: पदार्थः
40020664.content: अपरं what else, किन्तु but, कृत्वा having done, अयं this (Ravana), विधानं arrangement, संविधास्यति will make, कौतूहलसमुत्पन्नः filled with curiosity, यास्यामि I will go, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama

40020664.author: Translation
40020664.content: What other plan will this Ravana make after this, but filled with curiosity, I myself will go to the abode of Yama.

40020665.author: पदार्थः
40020665.content: विमर्दं conflict, द्रष्टुम् to see, अनयोः of these two, यमराक्षसयोः of Yama and the Rakshasa, स्वयम् himself,

40020665.author: Translation
40020665.content: He himself wished to witness the conflict between Yama and the Rakshasa. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे विंशः सर्गः ।। 20 ।। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
